---
title: "iPredict Contract on Australian Federal Election Date"
date: "2010-02-17"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets"]
---

This Friday, iPredict launches a [host of new contracts](https://www.ipredict.co.nz/Main.php?do=blog&page=%253Fp%253D324 "host of new contracts") with full market-maker liquidity, including a contract on the Australian federal election date and the outcome of the March RBA Board meeting.
